protocol.answer_generation: compact PRME first, then a fresh no-memory baseline, with no source or configuration changes after launch
protocol.checkpointing: Schema-2 launch manifest plus durable exact-request checkpoints; all failures and UNKNOWN answers are retained
protocol.claim_boundary: This is a post-result compact-context development study on the same 149 questions already measured at 32K. It can guide efficiency work but is not a new holdout or a competitor result.
primary_metrics: overall and per-category exact score for each system
paired wins and losses versus no memory
context-token reduction versus the completed 32K development reference
protocol.question_order: released dataset order after the original registered filter
protocol.stopping_rule: Run every registered question for both systems; do not tune from intermediate outcomes. Infrastructure failures may resume from exact checkpoints.

purpose: Post-result development test of product-default 4K PRME context against a fresh official no-memory baseline

selection.excluded_reason: Questions inspected by any earlier LongMemEval-V2 smoke, diagnosis, or recovery run are excluded before answer generation.
